title: I’m in Palace Warfare, And You’re Watching a Show???
author: Dreams on the Mountain
synopsis:
Harem Battle Royale, step up if you dare ^_^

[Pure harem drama + No intelligence nerf + Sane worldview + Zero emotional drain + Cheerful and relaxed]

After dying, Qiuju transmigrates into the Qianyuan Dynasty, becoming a lowly palace maid.

Not wanting to wake up at 3:00 AM to work, she decides to seduce the Emperor...

Mini-goal: Become a concubine who only has to wake up at 5:00 AM at the earliest...

chapters.title: Borrowing a Corpse to Resurrect the Soul
chapters.content:
Qiuju was dead.

Right before dying, she had braved a raging fire to rescue nine children. Before losing consciousness, she thought: That's great. With her lack of parents, relatives, or family ties, she should definitely qualify for the Revolutionary Martyrs' Cemetery. Otherwise, with her meager savings, she really couldn't afford a burial plot and all-inclusive cremation services.

Then she found out she wasn't quite dead yet—

[Hello. For humans like you whose souls have left their bodies due to being on the brink of death, yet whose lifespans are not yet exhausted and who possess accumulated merit, we offer the following options—

One: We can provide an ordinary position as a runner in the Underworld of this world. You need only work for ninety-nine years, and combined with the merit you have accumulated, your next life will allow you to be reborn as a human in this world (Note: The underworld position comes with performance evaluations; failure to pass will result in corresponding extensions of your service term);

Two: We will send you back to your original physical shell. Before doing so, we will nourish your soul and eliminate any bodily side effects caused by the out-of-body experience. You will be able to live out your natural lifespan (Note: Respiratory tract damage caused by inhaling too much carbon monoxide in the fire, as well as skin damage and other physical disabilities from burns, cannot be restored);

Three: You may choose to transmigrate to a parallel world and begin another life (Note: The parallel world is randomized. If you are unfortunate enough to be assigned to an apocalyptic wasteland, please fend for yourself, as we do not provide round-trip spacetime tickets back to this world. Special reminder: If you choose this option, you will be granted an exclusive system as your assistant);

Ms. Qiuju, please make your choice.]

Qiuju: ……Option one would make any corporate slave cry just looking at it, option two means dragging out a half-dead, suffering existence, and while option three is terribly unfriendly to the perpetually unlucky, it's transmigration after all!

Who hasn't fantasized about transmigrating to another world?

There was no need to think at all. Instant selection for option three!

[If you are unable to choose……]

Qiuju quickly shouted, "I choose three!"

[Hello, Host. I am your system assistant 168. From now on, I will travel with you to a parallel world. I hope both of us can live in peace and reach the end of our natural lives.]

Before Qiuju could even reply, she felt as if she had been tossed into a spinning washing machine, tumbling round and round in a daze. Fortunately, since she was currently a disembodied soul, she didn't feel nauseous or want to vomit.

When the spinning stopped, Qiuju found herself floating in a dim, murky void.

Looking up, the moonlight was gloomy, the stars devoid of light.

Looking down, everything was pitch black, the path ahead unknown.

To put it bluntly, it was the hour of twilight—the sun had hidden away, the moon had not yet risen, the stars were dim, and heaven and earth were shrouded in gloom.

How should she put it? It suited her current state as a soul quite well.

Just as Qiuju was curiously looking around, the system's voice rang out—

[Successfully arrived at parallel world 1414555. Currently scanning for humans of the same gender, with over 50% facial similarity to the host, and who have been dead for less than three hours... Scan successful!

One: Imperial Eldest Princess Xiao Mingzhu, 5 years old, deceased for one hour, available for soul-borrowing resurrection;

Two: Li Shuyue, concubine-born daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan, 14 years old, deceased for two hours, available for soul-borrowing resurrection;

Three: Chunluo, a sweeping maid in the imperial palace, 20 years old, deceased for half an hour, available for soul-borrowing resurrection;

Host, those are the three choices. Pick one.

Warm reminder: Scanning consumes a massive amount of energy and cannot be repeated. The system's energy can only assist you in borrowing a corpse for resurrection three times, and you cannot choose corpses that have been dead for more than three hours. Please choose carefully.]

Qiuju began to ponder: Judging from these three options, her luck was indeed a bit subpar, as she had been randomly assigned to an ancient world.

The maid was ruled out first. After all, with imperial power reigning supreme, maids had no human rights; she might get her head chopped off just for stepping through a door with her right foot first;

The princess couldn't be chosen either. Kicking the bucket at just 5 years old meant either she had a congenital illness, or the harem scheming was so fierce that even a princess couldn't be tolerated;

That left only the concubine-born daughter of the marquis's estate.

Although she was a concubine-born daughter, she still came from a marquis's estate. Generally speaking, it was the concubine-born sons who were treated as thorns in the side by the primary wife, so a concubine-born daughter's situation should be slightly better.

Qiuju made her decision instantly: "I choose two!"

With a flash of darkness before her eyes, Qiuju felt the heavy weight of a physical body.

She opened her eyes and found herself locking gazes with an old woman with a long face, who immediately shrieked at the top of her lungs: "A corpse is twitching! !"

Before Qiuju could figure out what was going on, the old woman bolted out the door. Soon after, a large group of people rushed in, looking fierce and malevolent yet harboring a hint of terror as they pressed heavily down on Qiuju.

A heavily ornamented matron sneered, "Mother Wu, go fetch a packet of arsenic. I don't believe we can't kill her!"

Qiuju: ？？？！！！

What does this mean? Why are we suddenly bringing out arsenic?

At such a critical juncture, the system in her mind was still speaking in a matter-of-fact tone: [Memory transfer in progress... Transfer complete.]

Her temples throbbed fiercely for three seconds before Qiuju understood the situation—

This concubine-born daughter of the marquis's estate had a screw loose. She had engaged in a clandestine affair with a penniless scholar who had come to the capital for the imperial examinations, tasted the forbidden fruit, and gotten pregnant out of wedlock. Unfortunately, the family had already decided to groom her properly and send her into the imperial palace to curry favor through seduction.

Now that the matter had come to light, to protect the family's reputation, the primary wife had originally intended only to feed her an abortifacient and marry her off casually to some merchant family. But the dim-witted concubine-born daughter actually planned to make a scene, forcing the family to marry her off to that scholar who didn't even dare show his face……

The Marquis of Pingyuan, her father, flew into a rage, stating directly that he wished he had never given birth to such a daughter.

The primary wife offered a few hypocritical words of persuasion before turning around to hint to her trusted aide to prepare a lethal dose of abortifacient, and the concubine-born daughter had indeed been poisoned to death.

Just moments ago, everything had supposedly concluded, and they were busy washing the body in preparation for encoffining!

Qiuju felt her vision go dark. Pity she had already made her choice and had no choice but to swallow her bitter loss. She frantically spun her brain, trying to think of how to get out of this desperate plight.

Before she could come up with a solution, the long-faced old woman rushed back in with a packet of arsenic. Someone immediately stepped forward to pry open Qiuju's mouth, and that glaring white arsenic powder was dumped unceremoniously down her throat as if it cost nothing at all……

Li Shuyue, the concubine-born daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan, died of poisoning.

Returning to her soul state, Qiuju's entire being was dazed: She had wasted a chance just like that？？？

The marquis's concubine-born daughter was simply too much of a death trap!

The system remained completely unfazed, asking impassively: [Host, who do you choose next?]

Qiuju took a deep breath. Since the remaining two were both in the imperial palace, she would choose the first one. At least it was the status of an imperial princess, someone who exploited others.

Feeling the weight of a body once again, Qiuju took a lesson from her previous mistake and didn't rush to open her eyes. She focused on steadying her breathing, listening intently to the surrounding sounds.

Oddly enough, there was absolute silence, and she felt her head swimming, showing signs of a low fever.

[Memory transfer in progress... Transfer complete.]

Three seconds later, Qiuju wanted to unleash a torrent of profanity—

The Eldest Princess, Xiao Mingzhu, as the first child born in the palace, was deeply favored by the Emperor Qianyuan, and her birth mother was consequently elevated to the rank of Defei (Virtuous Consort). However, Xianfei (Wise Consort) had later risen to prominence and given birth to the Eldest Prince, leaving Defei deeply unsettled.

Earlier this evening, Defei had instigated the Eldest Princess to push the Eldest Prince into the lotus pond and then jump in herself, creating the illusion that the siblings had accidentally fallen into the water while playing.

The two children were fished out; the Eldest Prince drowned directly, while the Eldest Princess, being older and promptly treated by the imperial physicians, barely managed to survive.

However, this incident couldn't withstand close scrutiny, especially since the Eldest Princess was just a child and might blurt something out any day. Thus, Defei decided to murder her own biological daughter……

It is worth mentioning that Defei's trusted aide had sensed her mistress's intent and, to keep her mistress's hands clean, had preemptively smothered the Eldest Princess to death with a pillow.
