chapters.title: Must get promoted! This sweeping maid really can't do this job!
chapters.content:
After being speechless for a long while, Qiuju figured that since the trusted aide had already succeeded earlier, it should be a safe period now.

And indeed, hearing no abnormal sounds meant no one had discovered yet that the Eldest Princess was already dead.

That meant she still had a chance!

Opening her eyes, Qiuju was horrified to find a shadowy figure sitting by the bed. She must have been lying on the bed, and the room was pitch black, making it impossible to see the figure's face at all.

Yet the shadow seemed able to see her, perhaps because her eyes were shining too brightly.

"Mingzhu, your birth mother had no choice. Do not blame your mother."

Ahhhhh this is lethal! Defei was actually sitting right at the head of the bed?! Did this woman even breathe?! She clearly hadn't heard any sound! Could the Eldest Princess have a hearing problem?

No, don't think about that. What should she do now? What should she do?!

Before she could finish thinking, Qiuju saw the shadow move—

Faced with the pillow descending straight toward her head, Qiuju wanted to throw off the duvet and scramble away downwards, but it was completely useless. This body was too small, and having just experienced near-drowning, she couldn't even lift her arm!

Qiuju wanted to scream and shout as well. Even if it meant turning into a madwoman, it was better than dying an unexplained death!

However, her vocal cords were already injured from choking on water. The January lake water was bone-chillingly cold, and a fever had clearly set in. Oh right, this body was running a fever, so naturally, her ears couldn't hear clearly.

Enduring the tearing pain in her vocal cords, Qiuju managed only two "ah" sounds, which were even quieter than the mewling of a kitten!

The Eldest Princess, Xiao Mingzhu, died of asphyxiation.

"Damn it! 凸(艹皿艹)！！！@#￥&%#@……"

Returning once more to her soul state, Qiuju transformed into a manic internet troll, cursing without pausing for breath for five full minutes.

During the pause she took to catch her breath, she heard the system offering a warm reminder: [Host, the palace maid Chunluo has been dead for two and a half hours. If you don't hurry, you won't have another chance to borrow a corpse for resurrection, and your soul will simply dissipate.]

Qiuju took a deep breath, adjusted her mood, and said, "Let's go."

The moment she entered Chunluo's body, Qiuju felt pain all over. Was she running a high fever?

Her throat felt like she had severe tonsillitis, making it impossible to even swallow her own saliva. When she tried to make a sound, she found herself once again in a position where she couldn't speak!

Qiuju's brain felt like it was smoking; the pain made her want to ram her head against a wall—fortunately, she had no strength left...

With no other choice, she screamed loudly in her mind: [System! Can we communicate like this? Think of something, high fevers can kill people, you know!]

[To be precise, the palace maid Chunluo has already been burned to death by the high fever.]

[Damn it, you bloody well still have the leisure to talk about Chunluo...]

[Memory transfer in progress... Transfer complete.]

With her head aching as if it were about to split, Qiuju had no energy to check the memories. She simply said, [System, I feel like I'm going to die. My head is about to explode.]

The system drawled leisurely: [There is still one method currently: you can take a loan from this system to purchase special fever-reducing medication.]

Upon hearing the word "loan," Qiuju felt her brain clear up instantly. Oh boy, it was waiting right here!

[No loan! If you have the guts, just let me burn to death from the fever. Anyway, this life was a freebie to begin with!]

[...Then let's put it on credit.]

Qiuju felt her head smoking. If she didn't take medicine now, she might actually die.

She gritted her teeth: [Fine, put it on credit. Can you put the pill directly into my mouth?]

[Affirmative. Premium fever-reducing medication purchased, totaling 100 points.]

As the pill entered her mouth, Qiuju chewed it raw, swallowing the bitter taste while enduring a throat pain so excruciating it made her want to ascend to the Western Paradise...

After enduring this torture for a good while, Qiuju finally felt her headache subside.

She finally had the energy to receive the memories, and then... she could only say that, as expected, they were all equally disastrous traps!

Chunluo, 20 years old, an unremarkable sweeping palace maid.

However, earlier this evening, she had witnessed the Eldest Princess pushing the Eldest Prince into the lake and then jumping in herself. Returning to her quarters, the more she thought about it, the more terrified she became. Under the grip of sheer panic and terror, she spiked a high fever and burned to death...

Most importantly: The palace was currently conducting a thorough investigation into the falling into the water of the Eldest Princess and the Eldest Prince. Since such inquiries always started with close maids and eunuchs and heavily targeted other imperial concubines, the investigators hadn't reached anyone else yet.

However, as a sweeping maid whose cleaning duties included the Imperial Garden, questioning Chunluo was only a matter of time!

In other words, the people from the Emperor's inner circle would sooner or later come to question Chunluo, and they would likely resort to some "methods."

After all, this concerned the drowning of the Eldest Prince. If the Eldest Princess was truly smothered to death and no culprit could be found (after all, who would suspect Defei of killing her own son? Or perhaps Defei's trusted aide would simply step forward to frame Xianfei), beating a few palace maids to death would make for a convenient report, wouldn't it?

Qiuju wanted to curse again. Did it have to be this miserable?!

Wasn't there a single identity that allowed for peaceful lying flat? In fact, she could achieve the "try it and die" milestone at any moment. Hehe, trash transmigration! Trash system!

After muttering curses for a while, Qiuju suddenly noticed that her headache was gone, her throat had healed, and apart from being drenched in sweat all over, she felt like a new person.

Hiss—what kind of medicine did the system buy her? The effect was just a little *too* good, wasn't it?

Although she had recovered her health and felt capable of running a marathon, Qiuju still didn't dare open her eyes—

She was truly terrified. Moreover, the memories told her that Chunluo, this poorly-fated sweeping maid, shared a large communal sleeping platform with 15 other maids. Qiuju really didn't want to take the gamble of opening her eyes and seeing some maid staring straight at her...

So, it was better to keep her eyes closed and play dead for now, pretending to be fast asleep.

She might as well check out the system's functions to see if they could help her tomorrow and in her future life.

[System, introduce yourself, focusing on your functions.]

Qiuju's tone closely resembled that of a human resources manager.

System 168 rolled its data eyes and replied flatly: [Congratulations to the host for successfully borrowing a corpse to resurrect. This system is numbered 168, your transmigration cheat. You can issue commands in your mind, such as opening your personal profile.]

Qiuju tried it immediately, and before her eyes appeared a very ordinary personal profile—

[Personal Profile

Name: Qiuju (Perhaps you can change your name to Chunluo, since coming to a new world means a new life)

Gender: Female (Male-to-female transmigration is strictly prohibited)

Age: 20 (Based on the bone age of the current world)

Figure: 50 (Out of a total score of 100. A failing figure. In an imperial palace brimming with beauties, won't you feel inferior? Click to purchase [Slender and Graceful], [Voluptuous and Charming]……)

Beauty: 60 (Out of a total score of 100. A barely passing level of beauty. In an imperial palace brimming with beauties, won't you feel inferior? Click to purchase [Painted Eyebrows], [Peerless Beauty]……)

Stamina: 95 (Out of a total score of 100. Exceptional stamina. In an imperial palace brimming with beauties, you won't turn into a rag even after being used a thousand times, but first you have to be used. Click to purchase [Lucky Halo], [Allure the World]……)

Points: -100 (I hear that if you stay in debt too long, a certain system will make things difficult for you behind the scenes. You wouldn't want to test that, would you? Try it and you'll die.)]

Qiuju was speechless: That last sentence was definitely added by the system!

A system that proposed loans right at the door of death couldn't possibly have much morality. Besides, it wasn't even human; it probably didn't even possess the capacity for shame when it came to exploiting someone in distress!

Qiuju muttered to herself: I'll have to figure out how to earn points later. Upright and honorable as she was, she wasn't the type to default on debts.

Driven by curiosity, Qiuju then clicked into [Lucky Halo] to check it out—

[Item Introduction

Name: Lucky Halo.

Function: Boosts your luck value, ensuring smooth sailing in all endeavors!

Drawback: This item operates via causality, so you cannot reap what you haven't sown. Please use with caution.

Price: 100 points consumed per second of use.]

Qiuju was somewhat shocked. Mere palace warfare, and it had already brought out causality-type items?

The problem was, upon closer thought, this item was actually extremely practical! As long as it was activated, serving in the emperor's bedchamber would be guaranteed. Since all the women in the imperial palace belonged to the emperor, that created the most straightforward and direct chain of causality...

Qiuju's expression gradually grew excited—she wasn't actively trying to enter internal competition, but palace maids had no human rights!

Now that she was Chunluo, even if she had nothing to do with the affair of the Eldest Princess and the Eldest Prince, she would still have to wake up at 3:00 AM every single day.

3:00 AM! That was the hour when night owls hadn't even gone to sleep yet, and she had to wake up!!!

Within ten minutes of waking up, she had to get herself sorted, skip breakfast entirely, and head straight to work—cleaning the palace grounds.

In her memories, Chunluo just kept cleaning and cleaning until a little past nine when the palace pathways were finally done, only then having her first meal of the day.

After eating, there was no time to rest; the senior supervisory matrons would assign her to clean the courtyards of various imperial concubines.

This chore also carried risks. If a maid happened to look relatively pretty, she might become a target for the imperial concubines, making things like having her face scratched or being forced to kneel quite probable.

The most maddening part was: every single palace pathway had to be swept every day, and every single palace courtyard had to be cleaned every day!

Moreover, whenever she saw someone, she had to bow—not just a slight curtsy, but a full kowtow-style kneel. By the end of the day, her knees would be swollen; to be precise, Chunluo's knees had never once been free of swelling.

Compared to this, sharing a room with 16 people was practically nothing.

In fact, ever since she realized she had been randomly assigned to an ancient imperial society, Qiuju had mentally prepared herself and even decided to fashion some knee pads for her future use.

But seriously—having to get up and clean at 3:00 AM! Cleaning the entire imperial palace, no less! And doing it all day long! This was something she absolutely could not tolerate under any circumstances!

She had to get promoted!

This sweeping maid really couldn't do this job—

chapters.title: A Sweeping Maid Who Doesn't Want to Get Promoted and Get a Raise Is Not a Good Transmigrator
chapters.content:
A sweeping maid who doesn't want to get promoted and get a raise is not a good transmigrator.

However, while her determination was set, she hadn't yet figured out how to secure that promotion.

The best outcome would be leaving the imperial palace, but the Great Qian Dynasty had no rule stating palace maids could leave the palace to marry upon reaching a certain age; there was only

Some palace maids, having won the favor of a concubine, were married off to the concubine's maternal family—cases like that.

As for the other palace maids, they were either moved to other quarters to await death when they fell sick, or they grew old and died in the palace. Of course, when they were close to dying, they would still be moved to the outer quarters.

After all, dying inside the palace proper was considered bad luck.

As for escaping by her own means... Qiuju didn't even entertain the idea. Wandering about outside required an official travel permit (an ID card), and people without household registration could only flee to the mountains.

Penniless, unable to farm, and unable to hunt, Qiuju had no desire to receive a thorough beating from Mother Nature.

Therefore, for the time being, the only option was to continue surviving in the imperial palace; at least food and lodging were guaranteed.

(Two meals a day are still meals, considering ancient people only ate two meals a day, alright? Besides, palace maids get new clothes all four seasons of the year—an alternative kind of employee benefit.)

To get back to the point, a palace maid who wanted to get promoted had basically two paths—

First, of course, was to become a concubine of the emperor. But just like in the personal stats page, Chunluo had a body rating of 50 and a beauty rating of 60—she had zero core competitiveness!

Although Chunluo's facial features were passable—after all, she shared a 50% resemblance with Qiuju—having been malnourished since childhood and subjected to the wind and sun, her skin was sallow and rough, which completely ruined everything!

Moreover, being a newcomer, Qiuju wasn't yet ready to offer herself to the emperor. Although she wasn't particularly hung up on chastity in essence, when the crucial moment came, she would make the sacrifice if necessary.

But... sigh, it's just that the "hardware facilities" didn't permit it.

Second, to upgrade from a sweeping maid who cleaned everywhere to a specialized palace maid.

For instance, being in charge of tea leaves in the tea warehouse, managing fabrics in the cloth warehouse, or becoming a little sidekick by some consort's side. That would be much, much more leisurely.

Although she would still have to wake up at three in the morning, she wouldn't have to perform full kowtows constantly—just a slight knee bend in normal times—and she wouldn't have to endure the wind and sun outside. If she played her cards right, she might even get her own single room...

Of course, Qiuju was not satisfied with that.

Even though ancient society generally went to sleep by eight o'clock, she still couldn't accept the thought of waking up at three in the morning. Therefore, she still had to strive for the status of an imperial consort.

Because consorts generally didn't wake up until five o'clock. If she managed to reach the level of the empress, she could sleep in until six or seven. The empress dowager's level was even more wonderful—as long as she was thick-skinned enough, she could practically treat the bed as her home, and people would even feed her!

Therefore, the most urgent task right now was to find an opportunity to get a promotion.

First, get rid of this daily chore of sweeping floors, and then quietly become beautiful with the help of the system's black tech...

Thinking of this, Qiuju tapped on [Slender and Graceful] to take a look—

[Prop Introduction

Name: Slender and Graceful

Function: Directionally alters your physique, making you light, delicate, and soft!

Flaw: This item is in pill form, requiring oral ingestion, and it will take 30 days after taking it to slowly complete the correction. (Note: If bones are deformed, a dull ache will persist during correction; if the body is obese, weight will drop rapidly during correction; if the body is emaciated, appetite will increase significantly during correction)

Price: 100 Points]

Qiuju: ...Very well, I can't afford it.

[System, how do I acquire points?]

[There is a dynamic posting feature on the mall page, connected to the Interstellar Network. You can post texts, pictures, videos, and any other form of updates. 1 like can be exchanged for 1 point.]

Qiuju opened that feature, momentarily at a loss as to what to post.

The system reminded her: [Don't post some whining moans or meaningless stuff; Interstellar netizens won't buy it, and it will cause your account to drop into the general zone, from which it'll be very hard to fish you out.]

Qiuju: ...Understood. She used to be a netizen herself, after all. Which of those mega-popular media accounts didn't rely on gimmicks?

After a moment of thought and careful wording, Qiuju published her first update:

[I died, and was reincarnated as a palace maid in the harem of the emperor husband. My own younger sister took my place to become the empress, and my close friend is five months pregnant...

At this moment, I choose—

1. Beat the dog brains out of the scumbag emperor;

2. Tear apart the fake younger sister with my bare hands to retake the empress's seat;

3. Kick my best friend's pregnant belly and send her straight to the Western Heaven;

4. Pretend I know nothing and silently endure everything.

Friends, how should I choose?]

System: [...Your skill at fabricating nonsense is quite deep.]

Qiuju: [过奖过奖,毕竟没吃过猪肉也见过猪跑嘛……对了,能不能先赊账让我买个道具啊?]

[Cannot.]

[Don't say cannot so fast. Look at my situation, it's not like I can't pay it back, right? Invest a step early, and I can become beautiful a step early.]

[This system can lend you points, but according to the rules of the underworld, nine out and thirteen back.]

Qiuju sneered: [Why don't you just go rob someone?]

The system replied flatly: [I am already robbing you.]

Alright, alright, so sincerity really is the ultimate killer move, huh?

Qiuju stopped talking nonsense, exited the system interface, and planned to get a good night's sleep. Having just died and then being put through this much turmoil, her heart was exhausted too.

No sooner had that thought crossed her mind than Qiuju heard a "creak" sound, followed by a voice ringing out: "It's almost the Yin hour, you lazy lot, aren't you getting up?!"

Sigh, so this was three in the morning...

Following the memory of Chunluo, Qiuju slowly blinked, then got up alongside fifteen other sisters to put on her clothes and shoes.

The January weather was still cold, and everyone wore winter clothes, but the water used for washing faces and rinsing mouths was ice cold—it felt almost cold enough to freeze their fingertips off.

Moreover, aside from everyone using their own cups for rinsing mouths, there were only four large washbasins for washing faces, which were shared.

Qiuju sighed once more: ...Sigh, this sweeping maid gig really can't go on!

Barely managing to wash her face, she helped her good sisters from her memories comb their hair, and the group of sixteen walked out into the courtyard to assemble with the palace maids from the other three rooms.

Their direct superior, Mammy Lin, held the roster and called out names: "...Chunluo, you few are sweeping all the palace pathways in the Western Six Palaces today."

When the person beside her curtsied and acknowledged the order, Qiuju almost failed to react to the fact that Chunluo was her. Fortunately, she was standing at the back, and the light was dim enough to obscure her, so she barely managed to muddle through.

Sigh, it seemed she still needed to get used to this new name. Chunluo Chunluo, a spring radish?

Come to think of it, she felt a little hungry...

But they wouldn't be able to eat until nine o'clock at the earliest, and it was only a little past three right now... This is killing me!

Chunluo kept her face straight and blank, moving with the stream of people toward the door.

Then she was handed her tool—a court broom. This broom was neither inlaid with gold nor trimmed with silver; it was completely ordinary and slightly old.

And then the sweeping began—sweeping, sweeping, sweeping...

There was no dust, and there was no trash, but she had to sweep from beginning to end.

After going through such a sweeping session, Chunluo's first sensation was a sore lower back, followed by sore legs, considering she had been standing and walking the whole time.

Moreover, perhaps because she was sweeping the Western Six Palaces, as the sky was just turning bright, she encountered Noble Consort De riding in an imperial sedan chair, Talent Liu walking on foot, Noble Lady Hua, and Noble Lady Ying, resulting in four kowtows in total.

She also received four pieces of gossip in the process, the biggest of which was that yesterday the Eldest Princess and the Eldest Prince had fallen into the water; the Eldest Prince had drowned, and the Eldest Princess had also inexplicably died.

That word "inexplicably" was used very cleverly, because the well-informed palace maids all knew that yesterday the imperial physicians had cured the Eldest Princess before leaving the Hall of Eternal Longevity, yet in the dead of night, the Eldest Princess suddenly passed away!

Wasn't there plenty of room for speculation in that?

For instance, that the Eldest Prince's ghost was lingering and seeking revenge in the middle of the night...

Chunluo: ...Seriously, when I first heard it, I thought it would dig up Noble Consort De's "maternal love," but it ended up heading in a supernatural direction. Sigh.

Then Chunluo was forced to listen to the gossip that Talent Liu practiced the zither every day, while Noble Lady Hua and Noble Lady Ying practiced dancing every day, yet after three years in the palace, none of them had ever been promoted in rank or gotten pregnant.

Uh, speaking of this, a mention had to be made: the current emperor, Xiao Zheng, was 25 years old and had no sons to his name.

Yes, the Eldest Princess and the Eldest Prince were the only two children, but both had died yesterday.

Though children were few, the consorts in the palace were not lacking: the Empress, Virtuous Consort, Noble Consort De, Consort Xin, Lady Lin, Talent Liu, Talent Lu, Talent Hu, Noble Lady Hua, Noble Lady Ying, Noble Lady Cheng, and Noble Lady Song—a full dozen of them.

You must know, this didn't even count the eight bed-warming palace maids by the emperor's side who lacked formal titles.

Chunluo could not help but suspect that the emperor likely suffered from low sperm count.

Uh(⊙o⊙)... If that were true, wouldn't she have great prospects?

╰(*°▽°*)╯!

chapters.title: heard that gossip and sweeping go very well together... except for the exhaustion.
chapters.content:
Word has it that gossip and sweeping go wonderfully together... except for the exhaustion.

Perhaps because her physical stamina was exceptionally good, Chunluo's sore lower back and legs felt almost psychological. When she heard it was time for meals, she walked very fast.

However, today was quite a coincidence; the head eunuch from the emperor's quarters and the men from the Punishments Department had come together to interrogate people.

Mammy Lin bowed and scraped with an extremely respectful attitude, immediately pointing out the people who had cleaned the Imperial Garden yesterday, and Qiuju was naturally among them.

The hairless, white-faced eunuch glanced coldly and raised a hand: "Take them away."

Qiuju: ...Couldn't you at least let us have a bite to eat first? I have a feeling I'm going to starve to faint during the interrogation.

Upon arriving at the Punishments Department, she indeed saw torture instruments covering an entire wall.

The questioning was conducted one by one. Qiuju was neither at the front nor the back, and her statement was vague:

"This servant kept her head down the whole time, and when I heard the sound, I got a fright, but... but I didn't dare look around blindly. It was only later that I found out the two Highnesses had fallen into the water..."

And then she was let back out.

Whole and intact, completely unharmed.

Inwardly surprised while showing no flaws on the surface, Chunluo thought she could finally catch breakfast before noon, but she was quickly summoned by Mammy Lin again.

"Chunluo, you go to the Hall of Precious Glory."

There were a total of six palace maids called in for questioning, and now all six had been assigned new destinations, all of which were remote places ignored by everyone all year round.

The Hall of Precious Glory sounded nice, but it was located at the far western end. There was only a single Buddha statue inside, and neither the current emperor nor the empress dowager believed in Buddhism.

Following the example set from above, the Hall of Precious Glory had been abandoned for many years, and it was only cleaned once a year during the New Year festivals.

How should I put it? Any palace maid with ambitions wouldn't want to go to a remote place like that, because there wouldn't even be any opportunities to climb up.

After all, sweeping maids still had a chance to see the consorts and His Majesty the Emperor.

However, for Qiuju, it was exactly what she wanted.

Because she really didn't like sweeping floors.

And wanting to quietly become beautiful definitely required avoiding crowds, right?

The Hall of Precious Glory didn't even have a gatekeeper; it was just her alone! It couldn't possibly be more perfect!

Of course, a thrilled Qiuju still put on an appearance of being extremely reluctant to go, dryly pleading with Mammy Lin a few times. Only after being ruthlessly refused did she go back to her room to pack her things and then leave with apparent reluctance.

Along the way, Chunluo walked and sighed: Sigh, waking up at three in the morning, and now it's afternoon without a single bite to eat.

But there definitely wouldn't be any food now; she could only wait for the evening meal.

Arriving at the Hall of Precious Glory, it was indeed a sight of long-term abandonment. Not to mention the buildings that needed repairs, even the grass growing out of the cracks in the stone slabs in the courtyard was up to her calves.

Entering the back hall, Chunluo first cleaned out the room where she would sleep and stopped there, collapsing directly onto the newly made bed.

Starving, and exhausted.

This life was truly too difficult.

Chunluo dozed for a bit before hurriedly scrambling up to head over to the Imperial Kitchen to wait for food.

Now that she was without a group, she had to fetch her own daily water supply, and the same went for meals. Because she was on her own, she would end up at the back of everyone else's line—anyway, much like how single mothers and orphans get bullied (?).

Still, she managed to get her meal, and the chefs who cooked for the palace maids and eunuchs didn't deliberately make things difficult; the food was hot and tasted pretty good.

Returning to the Hall of Precious Glory once more, the sky had already grown dark, and the palace gates were about to be locked.

Physically and mentally exhausted, Chunluo wanted to wash her feet before sleeping, but in January, there was no hot water... Oh well, her feet weren't that dirty; she'd just make do for one night.

Then she lay down on the hard wooden bed and closed her eyes.

After a long while, the post-time-travel sequelae kicked in—accustomed to playing on her phone every night until her eyes couldn't stay open, accompanied by various streams of information filling her brain, plus car horns acting as white noise to lull her to sleep...

In the tranquil and pitch-black imperial palace, she couldn't fall asleep at all.

Chunluo had no choice but to open the system interface and check her updates. Happily, by the afternoon, the likes had already risen to 2,333, and comments to 23.

One of the comments had been voted straight to the top: [What is there to choose? Why not want all of it? Silently endure everything = quietly gather strength, and then hit them with the combo of beating them up, tearing them apart, and kicking them! Sister, go for it!]

Chunluo silently liked this comment.

Although the character relationships were fake, she actually quite wanted to do it like that.

At this moment, the system asked: [Host, shall we convert the 2,333 likes into 233 points?]

[Yes.]

[Converted. Detected that you are on credit for 100 points, shall we settle the balance?]

Qiuju: ...Well, suddenly I'm feeling a little hesitant.

Then the system's voice changed tone: [Host, are you trying to renege on your debt? Do you know that the interstellar network is actually rather unstable?]

Qiuju's breath hitched. This system was truly formidable, threatening to cut the internet cable at the slightest disagreement.

She hurriedly smiled ingratiatingly: [Don't be like that. Did I say I wouldn't pay back? Go ahead and deduct the 100 points. Thank you, system.]

Checking her account balance again, it was indeed 133 points.

Next was purchasing the items to become beautiful.

Chunluo started shopping around—

[Slender and Graceful] 100 points, [Voluptuous and Charming] 100 points, [Petite and Exquisite] 100 points, [Graceful and Poised] 100 points, [Tall and Upright] 80 points, [Curvy Figure] 50 points...

Chunluo immediately clicked on—

[Prop Introduction

Name: Curvy Figure

Function: Directionally alters your physique, giving you breasts in the front and buttocks in the back!

Flaw: Cannot alter the original bone deformities, obesity, emaciation, etc., of the physique, and will only slowly adjust the breasts and buttocks according to height.

Price: 50 points.]

Sure enough, you get what you pay for. Compared to [Slender and Graceful], which offered light, delicate softness along with all-around body sculpting and correction, this [Curvy Figure] did exactly what it said on the tin.

However...

Chunluo glanced down at her flat chest. This will do!

Anyway, with her thin arms and skinny legs, she had no use for those other functions at all.

Points -50.

Now her body issues were solved, but her face needed some work too. Although her features were decent, her forehead was flat, her nasal bone was large, and her hairline was receding slightly...

[Fish-Dazzling and Goose-Alighting Beauty] 500 points, [Moon-Shaming and Flower-Abashing Beauty] 500 points...

Chunluo was curious—what kind of effect did these have to be priced so high?

[Prop Introduction

Name: Fish-Dazzling and Goose-Alighting Beauty

Function: Directionally alters your appearance, giving you the face of a powerful combination of two of the Four Great Beauties—Xishi and Zhaojun!

Flaw: This item has no flaws. If being too beautiful is also a flaw, then I suppose it has that.

Price: 500 points.]

Qiuju: ...Very well, I don't need to look at [Moon-Shaming and Flower-Abashing Beauty].

She continued shopping around—

[Eyebrows Painted Like Pictures] 200 points, [Incomparable Beauty] 200 points, [Flower-Like Countenance] 200 points, [Delicate Features] 100 points, [Bright Eyes and White Teeth] 50 points...

[Prop Introduction

Name: Bright Eyes and White Teeth

Function: Directionally alters your appearance, giving you bright eyes and white teeth.

Flaw: Will not alter your bone structure, hairline, eyebrow shape, eye shape, nasal bone, lip shape, or tooth shape.

Price: 50 points.]

Chunluo hesitated quite a bit because the function really was a bit lackluster, but thinking of her yellowish teeth seen in the reflection of the water basin... she decided to whiten her teeth first.

Points -50.

Now only 33 points were left.

Chunluo went to look at the skin section, because skin subjected to year-round labor was truly rough.

But... [Skin Like Congealed Fat] cost 600 points. Let's pass, let's pass; better look at something else.

Anyway, she didn't have to sweep floors every day anymore, so as for her skin... she could nurture it slowly. Ahem, alright, fine—she'd wait until her points were sufficient.

Then Chunluo found out that points were truly never enough; there were so many items she desperately needed!

For instance, [Traditional Chinese Medicine Mastery] cost 2,000 points. Being in the imperial palace, knowing a thing or two about medicine would give such peace of mind.

For instance, [Classical Dance Mastery] cost 600 points. To seduce the emperor, mastering some talent was also quite necessary.

Pity, she couldn't afford any of them.

chapters.title: As if an immortal fairy had descended from the heavens, untainted by mortal food.
chapters.content:
Chunluo fell asleep while browsing through the mall items and lamenting how poor she was.

The next day, her long-established biological clock caused her to open her eyes at three in the morning, leaving her utterly speechless.

The room was pitch black, you couldn't see your hand in front of your face. Chunluo rolled over and went back to sleep.

When daylight finally broke, Chunluo finally crawled out of her warm bedding, tidied herself up, and headed to the Imperial Kitchen to wait for food.

While waiting, she ran into her ill-fated sister-in-misery from yesterday's assignment and had a chat.

From her, Chunluo learned that the dual deaths of the Eldest Prince and the Eldest Princess had been finalized as an accident, and the Empress had issued a decree forbidding anyone in the palace from discussing the matter further.

The Virtuous Consort was extremely heartbroken and was now bedridden, while Noble Consort De was also heartbroken, weeping floods of tears day in and day out.

However, rumors whispered through the grapevine: the two of them suspected that the Empress was the one who made her move...

Well, when they spoke of it, it certainly wasn't that blunt, but those in the know understood. After all, the Empress had no children of her own, so making a move against someone else's made complete sense.

Knowing the truth, Chunluo could only click her tongue mentally: Who would have thought that the outwardly gentle and amiable Noble Consort De was someone capable of instigating her daughter to commit murder, and later smothering her daughter to death with her own hands?

There was truly no such thing as a viper with a sweeter face.

Thus, maintaining the routine of visiting the Imperial Kitchen twice a day to wait for food, fetch water, and listen to gossip, Chunluo safely survived for a month in the imperial palace.

During this period, the number of likes on her first posted update rose to 2,555 before stopping moving for several days, forcing her to update with a second one—

[I silently endured and observed from the shadows, only to discover the Empress and the Grand General having a clandestine tryst, engaging in passionate clouds-and-rain romantic encounters in the dilapidated Hall of Precious Glory...

At this moment, I choose—

1. Scream at the top of my lungs to summon the imperial guards and expose this pair of...]

scumbag and slut;

2, keep silent and help secretly, expose them dog-eat-dog in the future;

3, pretend to panic and cast amorous glances, join their throuple;

4, walk right past like nothing happened.

Friends, how should I choose?】

A few days later, 3,333 likes.

A bunch of netizens in the comments spamming option 3, option 3, you *must* choose option 3...

Chunluo directly ignored it, and successively purchased [TCM Mastery], [Skin Like Congealed Fat], and [Brows Like Painted Hills].

And her personal page changed as well——

【Personal Page

Name: Qiuju (Chunluo)

Gender: Female (absolutely zero possibility of a male transmigrating into a female body)

Age: 20 (based on the bone age of the current world)

Figure: 70 (out of a 100-point maximum, a curvaceous figure entirely devoid of any seductive and charming allure. In this imperial palace shrouded in beauties, won't you feel inferior? Click to purchase [Graceful and Flowing], [Plump and Poised]...》)

Beauty: 80 (out of a 100-point maximum, an unadorned, painted-hills-like appearance without any heavy, dramatic strokes. In this imperial palace shrouded in beauties, won't you feel inferior? Click to purchase [Fish Drowning and Geese Alighting], [Moon-Shaming and Flower-Abashed]...》)

Stamina: 95 (100 is the maximum, extremely excellent stamina. In this imperial palace shrouded in beauties, you won't turn into a rag even after being used a thousand times, but first you have to actually be used. Click to purchase [Halo of Fortune], [Allure the Masses]...》)

Points: 2888 (Points obtained by spouting nonsense; those interstellar netizens really haven't tasted fine delicacies before)】

Chunluo: ……Black cat, white cat, a cat that can earn points is a good cat!

She now knew that the content in the parentheses afterwards was all written by the system, and she... really felt like beating the system up.

Of course, even if she wanted to beat it up she couldn't reach it, she could only think about it.

Because these props slowly changed the body in a subtle, imperceptible way, Chunluo honestly went into hiding.

*

In the third month of spring, grasses grow and orioles fly.

More than a month had passed since the premature deaths of the First Princess and the First Prince, and the inner palace, which had been quiet for a long time, grew lively once again.

Perhaps it was because the emperor had returned to a childless state, and the imperial concubines in the palace seemed to have fallen out of his favor again with wombs that failed to deliver, the palace intended to host a small-scale draft and flower-viewing banquet.

Thus, the empress leaked the news, and noble matrons with ideas submitted formal calling cards into the palace.

The empress then set the date for the Shangsi Festival on the third day of the third month, inviting the matrons to view flowers in the Imperial Garden.

As soon as this news came out, Chunluo felt her opportunity had arrived.

After all, she now had brows like painted hills, a curvaceous figure, and skin like congealed fat; all that was lacking was to catch the emperor's eye, experience the clouds and rain, and be granted a formal rank.

However, as a palace maid, she couldn't wear overly vibrant clothes, nor did she have the money to buy jewelry, so it seemed she could only rely on "innate beauty."

Chunluo wasn't discouraged either; after all, whenever she looked in the water mirror these days, she was mesmerized by her own beauty, and every time she went out she had to disguise herself to look ugly. She had confidence in her face and figure!

Once the emperor was moved and they had physical intimacy... Heh heh, skin like congealed fat was no exaggeration; it was truly something one couldn't put down, wanting to touch it again even after touching it once.

So, step one, attract the emperor's attention——

Chunluo spent all her monthly stipend since entering the palace, and finally bribed the matron in charge of personnel arrangements for the Imperial Garden flower-viewing banquet.

And so, among the palace maids responsible for serving at the flower-viewing banquet, Chunluo was added.

Just past noon, the noble matrons brought their meticulously dressed daughters into the palace.

The noble matrons sat in the Kunning Palace drinking tea with the Empress, Imperial Noble Consort Xian, Imperial Noble Consort De, and other consorts, while the young and beautiful young ladies of noble birth were led by the first-class palace maids of Kunning Palace to the Imperial Garden to view flowers and stroll.

Chunluo had spent money that couldn't buy her close-up service, so she could only stand on the periphery. Fortunately, the spot where she stood had a rather luxuriant magnolia tree with shade, making it not too hot.

After the young ladies had strolled harmoniously for a while, the emperor, dressed in a dragon robe, arrived.

A flock of warblers and swallows curtsied in greeting, their voices delicate and gentle, carrying that unique youthful aura of young girls.

Chunluo naturally knelt down to salute just like the surrounding palace maids. Seeing them merely curtsy once, sour water bubbled up in her heart. So climbing upward really admitted no delay!

With her brows lowered and eyes submissive, Chunluo heard a male voice ahead say, "Rise."

"Thank you, Your Majesty."

Chunluo rose along with the others, her gaze fixed straight ahead.

Mainly because she couldn't see anything anyway, since the emperor was surrounded by a dozen or so young ladies of noble birth.

Besides, she had seen the emperor before. In the past when she swept floors, she would also be on rotation to sweep the area around the Qianqing Palace. In her memory, he was a tall, long-legged, handsome man.

Coming from generations of imperial optimization in looks, no matter how one thought about it, it wouldn't be too bad.

The young ladies in front tried hard to strike up a conversation, talking for a moment about how pretty the flowers were, and for another about how nice the weather was. The emperor himself seemed unenthusiastic, replying to everything with an "Mn."

Chunluo watched their route of advancement, pondering the right moment to attract the emperor's attention.

Naturally, she had thought of a method long ago, and it wasn't any sort of brilliant tactic either—just the usual cliché show-off trick: what if a flock of butterflies suddenly flew over and specifically stopped around her?

The weather nowadays wasn't actually warm enough yet, and not a single butterfly was in sight, so Chunluo had spent points to buy butterflies from the system mall...

"Ah! Butterflies!"

"Really, so many butterflies!"

Accompanied by the gasps of the young ladies, a flock of colorful butterflies fluttered over. The butterflies paused and flew again, lingering the longest in front of a pale purple magnolia tree in bloom.

And right beside that magnolia tree stood a palace maid in green, with lowered brows and submissive eyes.

The maid's attire was extremely plain, with only a wooden hairpin in her hair, but several blue morpho butterflies just happened to land on that hairpin, drawing everyone to cast their gazes upon her——

Jet-black hair, a full forehead, brows like wisps of smoke, lowered eyelashes like a crescent moon, a delicate nose tip, ruby-red lips, a neck as white as superior white jade...

Like an immortal descending from the heavens... [

chapters.title: s petty ideal: sleeping until waking up naturally, and opening one's eyes to the sun already high in
chapters.content:
After a moment, a group of noble young ladies clustered around the emperor as they arrived before the primroses.

The young ladies chattered away about how pretty the butterflies were. Among them, one particularly bedizened with pearls and jades stretched out a hand and said imperiously:

"Take your hairpin down, I want to see if there's honey smeared on it!"

Chunluo cautiously raised her eyes——

This movement revealed her entire face.

To everyone's surprise, this was not a face of breathtaking, national-beauty-and-heavenly-scent proportions.

Compared to the young ladies with their exquisite makeup, drawn brows, and touched-up lips, this face appeared exceedingly plain; at a glance, she did not look like a palace maid applying powder and rouge in order to climb the ladder.

For this scene, Chunluo had specifically applied powder, precisely to suppress her naturally stunning rosy cheeks and peach blossoms. With her complexion looking this pale, wouldn't it naturally appear plain?

And the noble daughters present all possessed rather good facial foundations; by comparison, she really couldn't match up.

However, this was precisely Chunluo's goal.

After all, one needed to be cautious when plotting to climb a bed; to seduce the emperor right in front of the prospective reserve concubines, and in a venue arranged by the empress herself, wasn't this courting death?!

This time, Chunluo only wanted to attract the emperor's attention, and find another opportunity for a chance encounter later.

"My lady, is it the wooden hairpin in this servant's hair that you want?"

Chunluo asked deliberately in a soft, delicate voice.

"Never mind, stand to the side."

Clearly, Chunluo's appearance had set this noble young lady's mind at ease; she believed the emperor could never take a fancy to such a plain and simple face.

So Chunluo curtsied in a salute, retreated to the side, and continued standing there.

At this time, the butterflies also seemed to have played enough, successively flying high into the sky and leaving without a shred of sentiment.

On the very day the flower-viewing banquet ended, Chunluo was transferred by the Grand Eunuch of the Imperial Presence to serve directly before the emperor.

Well, in a single bound she went from the very bottom to an imperial attendant maid.

The most absurd yet logical part was: Chunluo didn't have to do any chores at all; she just followed by the emperor's side, only needing to stand properly upon command from time to time for the emperor's viewing pleasure.

Yes, that's right, it was a replica of that immortal-like glance in the Imperial Garden.

For this, Chunluo was even rewarded with a pair of filigree butterfly hairpins inlaid with rubies and sapphires.

With those butterfly wings trembling and those rubies and sapphires flashing, Chunluo, who had never seen the world, simply couldn't put them down.

Returning to the main point, after becoming an imperial attendant maid, Chunluo moved into the Qianqing Palace, sharing a room with a palace maid named Xia Chan.

Every morning still meant waking up at 3:00 AM, but the Qianqing Palace had dedicated errand-running eunuchs to fetch water and meals, and warm water was used for washing faces and rinsing mouths every morning—a truly gratifying blessing.

Xia Chan was dedicated to making tea and practically engraved caution in words and deeds into her bones. Chunluo tried hard to fish for gossip but couldn't get anything out.

Therefore, having been in Qianqing Palace for three days, Chunluo had barely managed to recognize her colleagues, while other news remained completely unknown to her.

Moreover, living in Qianqing Palace, she lacked a legitimate excuse to go out, and couldn't even easily go find her former gossip buddies to chat.

Of course, if she wanted to go out she could, but if she went out too often and something happened later, she would be interrogated.

Chunluo wasn't in a hurry either; she planned to quietly and obediently act as a vase first, and wait until the timing was ripe before climbing the dragon bed.

Well, mainly because the palace had just held a small-scale draft, and a wave of young, fresh consorts were about to enter the palace. Faced with top-tier dishes, the emperor certainly wouldn't eat the thin congee and side dishes delivered right to his mouth.

Besides, throwing oneself at him would make her look cheap, devoid of the thrill of conquest.

In order to rise step by step in the future and enjoy enduring favor, she'd better wait quietly for good news!

*

The eighth year of Qianyuan, the eighth day of the third month, five imperial edicts were issued from the palace.

Five new mistresses were added to the inner palace.

However, all of them were granted the eighth-rank Baozhen (Precious Consort) rank. Thinking of the four Baozhens who still hadn't received a promotion after three years in the palace...

Tsk, the emperor was clearly a bit stingy.

Chunluo grew slightly more familiar with a few other imperial attendant maids, and thus successfully learned that these five newly entered Baozhens were respectively the daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan, the daughter of the Junior Vice Minister of Rites, the daughter of the Junior Vice Minister of Works, the daughter of the Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial, and the daughter of the Junior Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.

Chunluo cared most about the Marquis of Pingyuan's daughter—Li Ningyue, who was conferred the title of Baozhen Ning.

This Baozhen Ning was very likely the elder sister of the Marquis's concubine-born daughter whose body she had first possessed!

And she had learned when previously accepting the memories that Li Ningyue had reached her hairpin age this year and had already been discussing marriage with the family of her legal mother's side...

So, since the concubine-born daughter didn't enter the palace, they sent the legal daughter instead?

It was a pity that the brain-damaged concubine-born daughter thought about romance all day long and never paid attention to Li Ningyue's affairs, nor did she know if the marriage had been finalized. If it had been, then the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate had quite some guts.

Of course, thinking about all this was useless. After all, Li Ningyue had already entered the palace, and she believed anyone who knew about her previous marriage talks would tightly seal their lips.

Chunluo couldn't pry too much either, since they were unrelated strangers.

Days of serving as an ornamental vase in Qianqing Palace were very leisurely. Aside from waking up at 3:00 AM, which she still deeply detested... oh, actually there was one more thing——

"Today's brows... aren't like how they looked that day, like a wisp of smoke. Su Youren, go find those what-ma-call-it Luozidai [eyebrow pigments] for her, don't mess it up next time."

Chunluo, who had been critiqued: ……Seriously, the emperor might be sick; the willow-leaf brows right now clearly looked very good too! He just had to insist on drawing those far-mountain brows from that day!

Chunluo, who had grown somewhat bolder, raised her eyes and said in a soft, delicate voice, "Your Majesty, is this servant not pretty this way?"

Su Youren, who was about to step forward and bow to say "Yes," revealed a surprised look, then quietly retreated back to stand by the base of the wall.

Xiao Zheng, who was being questioned, carefully sized up the palace maid before him: apricot eyes, peach blossom cheeks, painted-like rosy face, willow-leaf brows fully displaying gentleness, pearly-white and glossy teeth as her vermilion lips parted and closed, clear, shallow, and yet exquisitely lovely.

Xiao Zheng suddenly grew interested. He clearly remembered that the palace maid he saw in the Imperial Garden on the Shangsi Festival did not look so... so tender and beautiful.

"Step forward."

So Chunluo stepped closer, only unlike her deliberate lifting of her gaze just now, this time she lowered her eyelashes. After all, there was an unwritten rule in the palace that one must not look directly at the imperial countenances!

Xiao Zheng reached out, cupping Chunluo's chin and sizing her up from top to bottom.

This action was actually somewhat offensive, making her feel as if she had turned into a kitten or puppy being played with, but Chunluo didn't react much. Instead, she deliberately held her breath for a few seconds, successfully turning her face red.

Well, two flushes of red flew onto her cheeks, setting off her fair-and-ruddy, exquisitely beautiful appearance all the more.

Xiao Zheng smiled and asked, "Did you deliberately apply powder that day? Your face looked so deathly pale. If it weren't for the butterflies dancing around so breathtakingly,朕 [Zhen] wouldn't have wanted to look at you again."

Chunluo: ……That was close.

Of course she couldn't admit it, for wouldn't that directly reveal that she harbored hidden thoughts?

"Perhaps this servant was heavy-handed that day, and accidentally applied a bit too much powder."

"You should pay attention to that in the future, but there's no need for heavy makeup either; Zhen wants to look at you a few more times. Alright, you may withdraw."

"Yes."

Chunluo was chased out just like that.

However, it was a common occurrence; the emotions of Xiao Zheng, this emperor, were extremely unstable. Sometimes he would suddenly smash a teacup while drinking tea, leaving a bunch of people kneeling in terrified silence, and sometimes he would be chatting away quite nicely and then suddenly chase people out...

Anyway, after experiencing the fickle nature of imperial joy and anger firsthand, Chunluo's thought of being promoted to a consort cooled down somewhat.

Of course, she hadn't completely given up, after all, waking up at 3:00 AM...

Although she had completely adapted her biological clock and would wake up right on time, Chunluo had pursuits—such as her humble ideal of sleeping until waking up naturally and opening her eyes to the sun already high in the sky.

And no matter how one looked at it, these could only be achieved by becoming the Empress Dowager.

So, she should still find an opportunity to climb the bed.

After all, if she dragged it out too long, the emperor might lose interest in her. [

chapters.title: Sincerely apologizing, but utterly unrepentant
chapters.content:
Chunluo kept looking for an opportunity, but there were simply too many consorts in the palace. The soups and pastries sent to Qianqing Palace every day could pile up to cover a large square table.

And they were all handmade by the consorts themselves.

Usually, all these things ended up in the bellies of the Qianqing Palace servants.

Chunluo naturally joined in eating and drinking; the things sent by the Empress, Consort Xian, and Consort De were the most delicious, and those from others came next.

Xiao Zheng would occasionally pick out one or two items to taste, but usually he only took a bite or two and left them, and nobody knew whether he liked them or not.

Chunluo deliberately observed several times: sometimes Xiao Zheng ate things sent by Consort De, yet summoned Baozhen Yao, who shared the same residence with Consort De, to attend his bed; sometimes he ate things from the Empress, yet summoned Talent Liu (Talent Liu being the Empress's cousin) to attend his bed...

It was as if he were openly instigating discord among these consorts.

Coupled with the previous premature deaths of the First Princess and the First Prince, the imperial presence definitely hadn't thoroughly investigated it—after all, Chunluo herself had merely taken a walk through the Ministry of Punishments back then, while Consort Xian and Consort De appeared to be joining hands to target the Empress...

To this, Xiao Zheng's attitude was simply ignoring it altogether.

That was truly chilling!

Because she discovered such signs, Chunluo hesitated a bit about climbing that dragon bed.

After all, a lustful and muddle-headed emperor wasn't terrifying, nor was a diligent and ruthless emperor terrifying, but if an emperor played with the inner palace consorts like toys... then she'd rather just be an ordinary palace maid who didn't get watched like a monkey in a show!

Chunluo thus fell into a dilemma.

Dragging it out like this, almost two months flew by in a flash.

Yet it wasn't without gains—perhaps Chunluo's concealment was so thorough that Xia Chan, who shared a room with her, became convinced she wasn't here to climb the dragon bed and finally let down her guard.

Thus, three months later, Chunluo finally obtained the Qianqing Palace Code of Conduct——

First, don't think about climbing the bed; the 1st, 2nd, 3rd... and countless palace maids who tried climbing it before were all punished to the Washing Bureau to do laundry.

Second, don't act as a double agent; those who previously leaked the emperor's movements and preferences to the consorts were all rewarded with a cup of poisoned wine.

Third, don't speak out of turn and don't do things outside your scope; whatever your duty is, say that and do that, and absolutely do not meddle in other work that doesn't belong to you.

Well, supposedly these were the three life-saving rules of Qianqing Palace.

Chunluo, who was still thinking about climbing the bed: Stumbled on the very first rule!

Fortunately she hadn't made up her mind yet!

As for the latter two... Chunluo hadn't had the chance to commit offenses against them yet.

Mainly because Chunluo was quite busy—Xiao Zheng seemed to have great interest in her, and almost as soon as day broke she had to attend by his side, performing her descent of a celestial maiden with lowered eyes every now and then.

Therefore, ever since she entered Qianqing Palace, Chunluo hadn't stepped outside. Even if consorts wanted her to be a double agent—er, to put it nicely, an intelligence peddler—she didn't have the opportunity to take money and handle business.

Now, she could only feel glad.

Although it couldn't be ruled out that Xia Chan was alarmist, since people gave warnings, there had to be precedents!

Chunluo was someone who listened to advice (and treasured her life), so she didn't question it at all, and even swore solemnly that she harbored zero thoughts regarding those three taboos.

Of course, every time she woke up at 3:00 AM, Chunluo would still curse up a storm in her heart, and then reaffirm her ideal of getting promoted and getting a raise.

It was just that a good opportunity was hard to find.

Time slowly stepped into May of the eighth year of Qianyuan.

The fourth day of the fifth month was the birthday of the Holy Mother Empress Dowager, and naturally there was a banquet in the palace.

Normally speaking, imperial attendant maids didn't need to follow along; the emperor only brought eunuchs by his side, but this time, Chunluo was specifically named to attend.

It clearly carried the momentum of becoming the second-in-command of Qianqing Palace.

Oh, the first-in-command was the Grand Eunuch Su Youren, and Chunluo expressed that she dared not contend with him.

In the morning, Chunluo served as an ornamental vase in the Imperial Study, during which she was critiqued by Xiao Zheng as if picking faults: she had applied too much powder again, and her face was too pale.

There was no helping this, for although Chunluo outwardly showed no intention of climbing the bed, in her heart she still harbored thoughts, so how could she not feel a guilty conscience?

She was about to meet her future cheap sisters-in-wedlock now, so shouldn't she keep a low profile?

To prevent her enterprise from meeting an untimely end before victory—getting disposed of by the imperial consorts for being too pretty before she even climbed the bed.

Ahem, although with Chunluo's current painted-hills-like face, she could barely rank in the top eight among the consorts of the inner palace, she was pretty nonetheless, which in the eyes of the consorts made her a hidden hazard.

Therefore, even though Chunluo was scolded, she properly admitted her mistake while stubbornly refusing to repent.

Anyway, once Xiao Zheng went to the banquet later, there would be enough brightly adorned consorts for him to feast his eyes on; presumably he wouldn't have the spare time to check whether her face was pale or not.

At noon, Xiao Zheng boarded the dragon carriage and headed towards the Palace of Ningshou, the residence of the Empress Dowager Shengmu.

Chunluo, dressed in the plain attire of a palace maid of the imperial presence, walked alongside the dragon carriage.

It was a fine day, and the sun was blazing fiercely. After walking for just a short while, Chunluo felt her face burning red from the sun.

That was what came with a low status; if she were an imperial concubine, she could at least hold a parasol. Alas!

Thoughts inevitably arose once again of climbing into the imperial bed as soon as possible and enjoying the privileges, but Chunluo’s face remained tranquil, her pace steady. Anyone who looked at her would say her training in court etiquette was quite good.

Upon arriving at the Palace of Ningshou, to show his utmost respect, Xiao Zheng did not ride directly inside; instead, he dismounted at the entrance and walked in to pay his respects.

After getting down, he glanced at Chunluo, paused for a moment, and said, "Su Youren, find her an umbrella later. Getting sunburned until her face looks like a monkey's rear end is unsightly."

Chunluo: ……I’ll just pretend I only heard the first half. At least she wouldn’t get sunburned in the future, right?

They made their way into the main hall of the Palace of Ningshou. The Empress Dowager, the Empress Dowager Shengmu, and various imperial concubines were all gathered there, surrounded by a harmonious and cheerful atmosphere, chatting and laughing merrily.

Xiao Zheng cupped his hands: "Your son greets the Empress Dowager and the Imperial Noble Consort."

At the same time, a room full of brightly dressed beauties stood up, performing graceful and lingering bows. Standing by the wall, Chunluo used her peripheral vision to size up these concubines.

The one in the phoenix robe and phoenix crown should be the Empress, while others such as the Virtuous Consort (Xianfei) and the Wise Consort (Defei) she couldn't recognize, since they lacked any special insignia.

However, she had to admit, they were all great beauties!

Even the Empress Dowager and the Empress Dowager Shengmu were very beautiful. Though nearly fifty, they looked to be around thirty, and they carried a soft maternal radiance. Er (⊙o⊙)… or should that be called a "wifely attribute"???

With lowered eyes and obedient demeanor, Chunluo’s thoughts ran wild, while up ahead the Empress Dowager had already told everyone to rise.

Then, the Empress Dowager Shengmu took Xiao Zheng’s hand, inquiring after his well-being just like any mother under heaven.

Of course, the most important thing was urging him to produce heirs. After all, Xiao Zheng was twenty-five years old and still had no children of his own; other people who moved fast already had ten-year-old kids...

The concubines on the side naturally offered shy, faint smiles, and then inadvertently cast flirtatious glances his way.

After chatting for a while, the time was right, and the banquet began.

Because it was not a milestone birthday for the Empress Dowager Shengmu, and she had specifically requested no grand celebration, there were no outsiders at this banquet. Even members of the imperial clan only sent gifts and did not attend.

Inside the hall were only members of the royal family. The seating was arranged in a "冂" (square-U) shape. In the seats of honor were, in order, the Empress Dowager, the Empress Dowager Shengmu, Xiao Zheng, and the Empress, with the concubines seated on the two sides.

A large open space was left in the middle, clearly intended for the concubines to perform their talents.

Sure enough, as soon as the dishes were served, someone stood up and announced her intention to play a tune to celebrate the birthday of the Empress Dowager Shengmu.

chapters.title: Chun
chapters.content:
Chunluo and a line of imperial eunuchs stood shoulder-to-shoulder by the wall, right behind Xiao Zheng. It was undoubtedly the best viewing spot—

The concubine playing the zither was dressed in a cyan-green gown, her slender fingers plucking the strings. Her eyelashes were slightly lowered, and the butterfly wings on her hair ornaments trembled gently, as if they might take flight at any second.

Looking at it, Chunluo found it inexplicably familiar, though she couldn't remember why for a moment.

Until the song ended and the concubine stood up to bow, sudden enlightenment struck Chunluo like a flash: Goodness gracious, was I plagiarized?！！！

It seemed that even though she stayed cooped up in the Hall of Mental Cultivation and never went out, her fame had clearly spread far and wide!

Moreover, the butterfly on this concubine's head was obviously even more lifelike than hers; those wings looked as though they were truly about to fly away.

Tsk, didn't this mean the butterfly hairpin given by Xiao Zheng had lost?

Chunluo pressed down her hand, which instinctively wanted to touch the butterfly hairpin on her head, thinking: Well, this is just great! Her original product had clearly been outshone by a pirated knockoff!

Even more ominous was: she had originally wanted to climb into the imperial bed, but now she had completely lost the chance!

After all, with a better dupe around, her job as an ornamental vase might even be gone!

Abominable! There was no place to file a grievance in this ancient era. Plagiarizing dog, knockoff goods, I’m so pissed!

On the surface, Chunluo wore a faint smile, while inwardly cursing three thousand times.

Soon, however, she no longer had the time to curse, because—

"The zither playing is mediocre, but she certainly knows how to dress up. Reward."

After making his commentary, Xiao Zheng added, "Chunluo, come up and serve my food."

Chunluo, having been called out: ……

Bearing the gazes of the entire assembly—oh wait, the Empress Dowager, the Empress Dowager Shengmu, and the Empress could not easily turn their heads to look at her due to their seating positions.

Therefore, Chunluo only had to step forward under the stares of the other sixteen concubines.

As she walked, the butterfly on her head naturally trembled gently, the red and blue gems flashing and reflecting each other's light.

Chunluo could only take comfort in the fact that the hall was filled with ice chests, and the face that had been sunburned red on her way here had cooled down. Right now, it must be pale and lackluster, appearing dull and ordinary at a glance, which shouldn't provoke any hostility.

……Or so she hoped.

While serving food to Xiao Zheng, Chunluo thought uncertainly.

After she had picked up a few dishes with her chopsticks, another concubine stood up, expressing a desire to perform a dance.

And so, dancing began in the center of the hall.

This time, Chunluo recognized them—they were the famous twin sisters in the palace, Baolin Hua and Baolin Ying. The two of them performed a duet dance, their sleeves fluttering and steps light, possessing a beauty quite reminiscent of startled swans taking flight or graceful swimming dragons.

When the dance concluded, Xiao Zheng naturally offered a comment: "Well danced, reward."

Performance after performance followed in this manner, but Chunluo remained busy serving food and pouring wine, not daring to watch the performances too closely.

Then... Xiao Zheng suddenly reached out, snatched the chopsticks from Chunluo's hand, and laid them aside.

Chunluo was startled, her body freezing for a split second. Then, she cast a quick glance at Xiao Zheng, who acted as if nothing had happened, and gradually calmed down.

Once she calmed down and thought back carefully, Chunluo realized she had been picking food for him far too frequently.

Yet she couldn't really be blamed. Previously in the Hall of Mental Cultivation, she was merely a mobile ornamental vase, and such tasks as serving food were normally someone else's job.

For Xiao Zheng to be driven to take action himself, it meant he was either full or stuffed to the point of being unable to bear it any longer...

Feeling a slight sense of alarm, Chunluo didn't dare pick any more food for him, and even poured only half a cup of wine.

Looking at the half-cup of wine, Xiao Zheng glanced sideways at the submissive Chunluo, feeling an impulse to throw this palace maid back to thoroughly relearn her etiquette.

Who pours only half a cup of wine?

However, upon seeing the palace maid's lowered gaze, her eyelashes curving like a crescent moon, he figured there was no need to be too harsh. After all, she would only be pleasing to the eye for a few years; in a few years, this maid's youth and beauty would fade.

Xiao Zheng withdrew his gaze, downed the unpleasantly short cup of wine in one gulp, and cast his gaze back toward the center of the hall.

After all, Consort Mother had brought it up again and again, and the key ministers at court also needed appeasement. He was still planning to select a couple of concubines to focus on, striving to add a couple of children next year.

It was just that these concubines, though beautiful, failed to arouse the slightest bit of interest in him.

Xiao Zheng’s gaze revealed disappointment, carrying the reluctant feeling of picking the tallest among a crowd of dwarfs.

Actually, matters of the bedchamber could still be quite enjoyable, and the concubines each had their own merits. Xiao Zheng didn't particularly dislike any of them, but overall, he simply couldn't muster any further interest.

After watching a round of performances, this banquet could be considered over.

Xiao Zheng had not yet decided on a candidate, but he was in no rush. He boarded the dragon carriage, though instead of returning to the Hall of Mental Cultivation, he headed toward the Imperial Garden.

Upon arriving at the Imperial Garden—to be precise, upon reaching the front of that magnolia tree—Xiao Zheng pointed a finger: "Go, stand properly."

Chun·The Mobile Ornamental Vase·luo obediently stepped forward, lowered her eyes, and stood properly.

Before her was a table laden with brush, ink, paper, and inkstone. Xiao Zheng was holding a brush and painting.

Ah, being a mobile ornamental vase meant having to moonlight as a model from time to time.

After standing for a while, Chunluo grew truly bored. She raised her eyes slightly to take a peek and noticed that Xiao Zheng’s face was slightly flushed, seemingly a bit drunk?

Yet he was still able to hold a brush and paint, and his standing posture was steady; he was probably just tipsy.

Chunluo swept her gaze around the surroundings and found that it was packed with imperial eunuchs. It seemed the Imperial Garden had been cleared out. Even if some concubine caught wind of the news, she would most likely not be able to get in.

"Don't look around. Lower your eyes."

"Yes."

Chunluo sighed: Standing completely still was truly boring, and standing for too long made the soles of her feet ache.

She could only resort to the foot-switching technique—first putting her weight on the left foot, and when she couldn't take it anymore, shifting to the right foot. Repeating this cycle at least made it somewhat more bearable.

After standing and switching feet like this for about an hour, Xiao Zheng, who was painting, had gone through a stack of xuan paper without finishing his painting.

It went to show that being tipsy was being truly drunk; he still couldn't figure out his painting after an hour!

Chunluo was reaching her limit. Walking around for an hour was fine, but standing in place as a punishment for an hour felt like years. Especially since she was standing under the magnolia tree, while the ice chest was over on Xiao Zheng's side. She was hot!

Should she just fake a heatstroke and faint?

If Xiao Zheng didn't care, Su Youren could easily brush the matter aside;

If Xiao Zheng summoned an imperial physician to check on her, she would simply wake up leisurely when the physician arrived, claim she felt dizzy and might have suffered from heatstroke, and surely the physician wouldn't expose her at that point...

Action follows desire!

Chunluo immediately pretended to feel dizzy, her body swaying slightly as she prepared to choose the best angle to collapse and faint.

Only to hear a voice first: "Forget it, today is not a good day for painting. Chunluo, come here."

Xiao Zheng stood beneath a large artificial parasol and beckoned to Chunluo.

Chunluo, who was reining in her momentum at the very last second, took a deep breath and walked over leisurely. Before she even got close, a wave of cool breeze hit her face.

Hah, there was even artificial fanning alongside the ice chest.

He really knew how to enjoy himself.

Chunluo quickly walked beneath the large artificial parasol and similarly enjoyed the fruits of her colleagues' hard labor. She instantly felt cool, and the stuffiness and heat in her chest dissipated quite a bit.

As Xiao Zheng picked out fruit from the ice chest to eat, he asked, "Seeing your face all red, are you hot?"

That question...

Torn between being polite and exaggerating the situation, Chunluo chose—

With a delicate and frail expression, she slightly furrowed her brows: "This maid is indeed a bit hot, and also a bit dizzy. Perhaps I'm on the verge of heatstroke."
