The storybook had a very ancient flavor, written in a semi-classical style with ink-wash illustrations. The story was still fairly interesting to read, though it required some mental effort.

Just as she was killing time like this, before she had read even a few pages, Xiao Zheng came over after finishing morning court.

Having gained experience this time, Chunluo first accompanied him to sit down and drink a cup of hot water, then changed him into casual clothes and served him breakfast.

After that, they went straight to the Imperial Study to review memorials.

However, Chunluo wasn't allowed to sit on the side and peek anymore; Xiao Zheng made her stand, lifting his gaze to look at her from time to time.

Carrying the vase profession to new heights.

Standing all morning, Chunluo kept her expression calm while cursing wildly in her heart because the soles of her feet hurt.

At noon, Xiao Zheng finally stopped writing, prepared to rest for a while, and incidentally eat some lychees.

Su Youren directed two eunuchs to carry in a lychee tree. Chunluo tactfully stepped forward to pick the lychees, peel them, and pop them into her own mouth.

After eating three in a row, Chunluo said, "Your Majesty, the lychees are very sweet, this maid will peel one for you."

Xiao Zheng just looked at her without speaking.

The silent majesty was chilling to the bone. Su Youren bowed his waist and cautiously retreated, terrified of being implicated.

Chunluo lowered her eyes as she peeled the lychees, acting as if she didn't feel a thing.

Xiao Zheng truly didn't plan on doing anything; he was just trying to scare someone, and if it didn't scare her, it didn't matter.

After eating a few lychees, Xiao Zheng rested his chin in his hand and began pondering matters.

"Who all sent things over today?"

Chunluo actually knew about this; she had strolled over to...

Checked.

"Send them all."

Xiao Zheng was somewhat speechless and asked again, "What about yesterday?"

"Sent them all as well."

"..."

Xiao Zheng had no choice but to wave his hand. "Have Su Youyi bring up the green-backed tablets. Oh, and make sure all the patterns are facing up and the characters facing down."

Chun Luo glanced at him. "Your Majesty, it's only midday."

Xiao Zheng gave a light chuckle. "What are you guessing wildly for? Pick two out in a moment."

"Pick them out for what?"

Truth be told, Chun Luo had a rough idea, considering Xiao Zheng had mentioned it earlier.

To be honest, Chun Luo was planning to use the [Aura of Fortune]. After all, the two imperial concubines picked out in a moment would most likely end up pregnant, so she absolutely could not pick a ruthless character like Defei.

They say good steel should be used on the blade's edge, and today these points simply had to be spent.

Soon, Su Youyi came up carrying a tray.

Chun Luo put down her lychee, went over to the basin of water to wash her hands, wiped them dry, and held up her hands, palms up and down, in front of Xiao Zheng.

"Your Majesty, this maidservant is going to pick then. Whoever I pick is who it is?"

"Naturally."

Chun Luo nodded. *[System, use the [Aura of Fortune] in a moment. You time it down to the second.]*

She walked over to the tray and casually picked up two pieces with her slender, pink-and-white fingers.

Xiao Zheng glanced at them: Noble Lady Ning of Yonghe Palace, and Noble Lady Mu of Jingren Palace. He smiled with an inscrutable expression. "Your luck..."

Noble Lady Ning was Li Ningyue, daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan; Noble Lady Mu was Mu Yanhuan, daughter of the Libationer of the Imperial Academy.

Although the Qianyuan Dynasty had not seen conflicts for a long time, Xiao Zheng had not slacked off; the soldiers still had to drill on ordinary days, and the Marquis of Pingyuan managed tens of thousands of soldiers in the suburbs of the capital.

The Libationer of the Imperial Academy didn't need much elaboration—his official rank wasn't high, but the civil and military officials throughout the court were inevitably tangled up in teacher-student and classmate relationships, not to mention having the reputation of a pristine scholar.

To put it in street parlance, both of them were tough nuts to crack.

chapters.title: To think that this bastard would turn around and shaft her!
chapters.content:
Chun Luo couldn't help muttering inwardly: Was the [Aura of Fortune] useless?

Otherwise, how could she have picked Li Ningyue?

Although she had no relation to Li Ningyue, she did know a thing or two about the dirty business of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate, and strictly speaking, it was the Marquis of Pingyuan's wife who had sent her away!

That pure white arsenic being poured down her throat was a sight still vivid in her mind to this day.

But since the green-backed tablets had already been picked, it wouldn't do to go back on it...

While Chun Luo was still deep in thought, Xiao Zheng had already made his selection, saying to Su Youyi, "Go to Yonghe Palace at the fourth quarter of the酉 (you) hour to fetch her."

Su Youyi immediately acknowledged the order. As he withdrew, he cast a covert glance at Chun Luo, sighing inwardly: *It seems this girl is just a flash in the pan. A place like Shuiyun Taoist Temple... what a pity...*

Chun Luo continued peeling her lychees.

Xiao Zheng leisurely ate a few, then waved his hand. "You eat them."

"Thank you, Your Majesty."

There weren't many lychees left anyway, and Chun Luo wolfed them down in a few bites.

Xiao Zheng sat there lazily and offered a critique: "Do things deliberately and at leisure; I wasn't urging you."

"This maidservant will certainly pay attention next time. Your Majesty, would you like some tea? Or perhaps some iced fruit juice?"

"Tea."

Chun Luo got up and brought over a small tray with one cup of tea and one cup of fruit juice.

The fruit juice, of course, was for herself.

Xiao Zheng acted as if he hadn't seen it, took a sip of tea, and said, "I have already issued an order today; we are expected to set off for the Chengde Summer Resort in five or six days. Remember to tell Su Youren so you don't leave things behind when the time comes."

Chun Luo reminisced for a moment, then said, "This maidservant is only packing some clothes and jewelry; a single trunk should be enough."

Besides, according to the rules, a palace maid was only permitted one trunk; if she had extra things, she would have to figure it out herself.

"Your Majesty, can we ride horses to Chengde?"

"We can. Can you?"

"No, Your Majesty, I'll be relying on you when the time comes."

"I don't have the leisure to teach you."

"Not riding horses and feeling the wind on the way to Chengde—wouldn't that be a lifelong regret? Your Majesty, what is this maidservant to do?"

At the tail end of her tone, Xiao Zheng felt the urge to smile, and the corners of his mouth indeed curved upward slightly.

"Alright, we'll talk about the horse riding when the time comes. We're heading back to the Imperial Study."

Chun Luo had no choice but to follow him back to the Imperial Study.

Thinking she'd just be a standing vase again, to her surprise, Xiao Zheng reached out, drew Chun Luo over, and made her sit down with him.

"Grind the ink."

Today's state affairs were clearly a bit numerous. Xiao Zheng didn't finish reading and approving them until past five in the afternoon. Although Chun Luo had been slacking off to the side, she felt just as tired as if she'd put in a full day's work.

As soon as she finished serving Xiao Zheng his evening meal, she slipped away.

Anyway, there was nothing for her to do for the moment.

As the sky darkened, Chun Luo still didn't light any lamps. She went straight to bed and started browsing the system store. From the outer room came a slight commotion—the Fengluan Chun'en carriage had returned.

Actually, consorts spent the night in Chenglu Hall, which was considered the rear hall of the Palace of Heavenly Purity. It was far enough away that sounds weren't usually clear.

Yet Chun Luo heard it, and quite distinctly at that.

Noble Lady Ning gave a dainty, coquettish greeting, and Xiao Zheng gave a bland summons to rise.

Chun Luo rolled over. Was it her imagination, or what? One was the front hall and the other the rear hall—why were her ears so sharp?

*[System, have my ears mutated?]*

*[The host may spend points for a physical examination.]*

Chun Luo hurriedly shook her head. She had spent 200 points to use the [Aura of Fortune] for 2 seconds, only to pick two tough nuts like Noble Lady Ning and Noble Lady Mu. It really was rather a shaft.

The next day, Chun Luo's biological clock woke her at 3:00 AM.

After lying in bed thinking for a bit, Chun Luo got up anyway and washed up along with a group of colleagues.

Of course, she had a washbasin all to herself.

After tidying up, Chun Luo returned to her single room. Since she had nothing to do, standing outside would only draw people's gazes. Although no one said anything aloud, she always felt those looks were uncomfortable.

Sitting in solitary confinement browsing the store for a while, Chun Luo found it boring and began to fuss over her appearance.

To be honest, many ancient hairstyles required hair pads because one's own hair simply wasn't enough, but palace maids certainly couldn't use those.

A palace maid's hairstyle was very simple: the hair was coiled into a double-snail bun. Those with status and influence would pin a pearl flower into it, while those with nothing used a uniform wooden hairpin provided by the palace.

As for dangling hair ornaments, jade hairpins, and the like, palace maids were not permitted to wear them.

Chun Luo had it slightly better because she possessed a single butterfly hairpin—one woven from fine gold threads and inlaid with gemstones.

Wearing it every day would definitely get boring, but she had no choice; after all, she was a vase meant for people to admire.

The only thing Chun Luo could change was her makeup.

*Tap, tap, tap—*

The sound of knocking suddenly rang out, giving Chun Luo a start. Fortunately, she wasn't drawing her eyebrows at that moment.

Chun Luo opened the door and saw Su Youyi standing at the threshold.

"Girl Chun Luo, it's almost the exact hour of Mao. You had best hurry over to the bedchamber to wait."

As she walked out, Chun Luo asked, "Why come call for me? Isn't there someone else over at Chenglu Hall?"

Su Youyi lowered his voice to confide, "Last night, His Majesty returned to the front hall to rest."

Chun Luo paused her steps and asked in a low voice, "His Majesty came back? Then Noble Lady Ning..."

"Noble Lady Ning has her own people from Chenglu Hall to wait on her."

Within the span of those two sentences, they reached the entrance of the bedchamber.

Indeed, the left wing-room where Chun Luo lived was right beside the bedchamber—exceptionally close.

As soon as she stood still, the head eunuch Su Youren tiptoed into the bedchamber and announced in the outer room, "Your Majesty, it is time to rise."

"Enter."

At this command, the eunuchs carrying washbasins, towels, toothbrushes (ancient version), tooth powder, garments, accessories, and other items entered the door one after another.

Chun Luo stood at the very back, feeling like this had nothing to do with her, and hesitated over whether she should go in.

Su Youyi glanced back at her, giving a urging look.

So Chun Luo went in.

Xiao Zheng, who was in the midst of washing his face, caught sight of her and asked, "Why are you here?"

A chill instantly struck Chun Luo's heart. Was Su Youyi screwing with her? Why?

Earlier, she had muddle-headedly saved Su Youyi, only to have this bastard turn around and shaft her! His name was Youyi ("Having Righteousness"), yet the things he did were the exact opposite!

While cursing inwardly, Chun Luo directly adopted a vase's optimal viewing posture on the surface, speaking in a delicate and dainty voice: "This maidservant... this maidservant has come to wait on Your Majesty."

Xiao Zheng glanced at her, ignored her, and continued washing up.

Chun Luo cautiously began to back away, but not daring to actually retreat all the way out, she stood close against the wall.

When it came time to dress, Xiao Zheng beckoned, "Chun Luo, come here."

Chun Luo took a few small steps forward and with utmost naturalness began to dress Xiao Zheng in his dragon robe.

Xiao Zheng opened his arms, lowering his gaze to watch her movements, and unexpectedly raised a hand to pinch her cheek.

"You don't need to come over in the future. You don't have to do chores like this."

What more could Chun Luo say? Was she supposed to admit that her IQ had gone offline and she'd been conned into coming here by a single sentence from Su Youyi?

Dropping hints on someone wasn't done that way; it would make her look altogether too stupid.

Chun Luo could only curtsy in thanks.

And by the way, as she was tying his jade belt, she launched a sudden surprise attack—she pecked Xiao Zheng right on the Adam's apple to demonstrate her deep adoration.

After all, she couldn't brew fancy soups, and if she had to speak grand romantic declarations out loud, she'd feel too ashamed. She could only express herself through action.

Though Chun Luo figured Xiao Zheng wouldn't care about such things, if she wanted to climb higher, she had to maintain this attitude—

chapters.title: This feeling was not bad at all; Xiao Zheng couldn't help but demand more.
chapters.content:
As for being kissed, Xiao Zheng didn't have much of a reaction, save for giving Chun Luo's cheek flesh another pinch.

The texture was wonderful; he wanted to keep pinching it.

However, the hour was already getting late, and he had to go to the Imperial Study to prepare for court.

With an unperturbed expression, Xiao Zheng strode off to "go to work."

As soon as he left, the atmosphere in the Hall of Mental Cultivation relaxed. Chun Luo looked left and right, failing to spot Su Youyi, so she had no choice but to go back to her room to rest.

Even if she had seen him, there wasn't much she could do. Was she supposed to confront him and get into a shouting match?

Chun Luo simply couldn't figure out why Su Youyi would deliberately harm her, or whose orders he was following.

After sitting and pondering for a while, her door was knocked upon.

Chun Luo was practically having a stress reaction. She waited a full second before going to open it, only to find that the person at the door was still that bastard Su Youyi!

"Girl Chun Luo, I really wanted to help you today. His Majesty was like that last night—he surely wasn't too satisfied. Under such circumstances, if you appeared, it would naturally yield twice the result with half the effort."

Su Youyi wore a distressed expression and spoke with utmost sincerity.

Chun Luo gave a faint smile. "I understand. Thank you, Second Brother Su."

Su Youyi instantly breathed a sigh of relief, his words tinged with even deeper guilt: "What are you thanking me for? Fortunately, His Majesty holds you in regard; otherwise, my cleverness would have backfired on me today. It's a great blessing that you aren't holding a grudge against me."

A string of internal curses ran through Chun Luo's mind, yet on the surface she was still comforting him: "How could I hold a grudge against you? Second Brother Su was only meaning well for me; I ought to thank you."

"Sigh, the way this turned out makes my face burn. I'll scout out a good opportunity for you later."

"Thank you, Second Brother Su."

Once the door was closed, Chun Luo dashed furiously to her bed, grabbed a pillow, and beat it a few times—what a piece of garbage, how dare he actually show his face again?! He really thought he was something!

After her burst of impotent rage, Chun Luo calmed down, went to the vanity mirror to redo her hair, and touched up her makeup.

Then, she went out to wait at the main entrance.

In her most stunning posture.

Consequently, when Xiao Zheng returned from morning court and caught sight of her, he actually stood at the entrance and stared her up and down for quite a while.

She was still wearing that green dress with its wide sleeves, revealing a section of her wrists where a mutton-fat jade bracelet dangled; her fingers were slender, her nails smooth and glowing with health.

Xiao Zheng studied those hands alone in detail.

After changing into casual attire and eating breakfast, Xiao Zheng had someone prepare brushes, ink, paper, and an inkstone—he wanted to paint!

Chun Luo: ...She always had an ominous feeling.

Sure enough, she stood stiffly upright all morning, while Xiao Zheng produced a stack of discarded drafts.

At noon, Xiao Zheng gave up and pulled Chun Luo along to eat lychees.

There were only nine lychees on the tree delivered that day. Chun Luo felt she needed to nourish herself, so she ate five of them.

In the afternoon, Xiao Zheng got down to serious business—reading and approving memorials.

Because he had wasted the entire morning, his pace was noticeably much faster, and for some routine greeting memorials, he merely glanced over them roughly and wrote the word "Read."

Just as dusk fell, Xiao Zheng finished approving all the memorials.

He stood up, stretched his arms out with a wave, and told Chun Luo, "You are not allowed to go to the main entrance next time."

Chun Luo 776777?: ...Are you blaming me? If you had managed to finish your painting in one go, would you have wasted the whole morning?

Naturally, she couldn't say those words aloud. Chun Luo lowered her gaze and kept silent, not answering at all. After all, if she stopped going even to the main entrance, wouldn't another channel for "seducing" Xiao Zheng be cut off?

Xiao Zheng didn't care whether she answered or not, heading straight out of the Imperial Study.

Su Youren had already prepared the evening meal.

This time, Chun Luo was permitted to join the table and enjoyed a good meal.

Afterward, she was scooped up by Xiao Zheng and taken to the bathhouse.

Chun Luo understood now: "flaunting one's charms" at the main entrance was indeed extremely effective!

The two of them got into the water bare. Chun Luo still couldn't quite let go of her inhibitions; she covered herself up and lowered her body until only her head remained above the water's surface.

Xiao Zheng's mouth curved upward, and he reached out to stroke her gently.

"You were originally just a sweeping palace maid, yet your skin has been nourished to an extreme degree."

Trembling slightly, Chun Luo replied, "This maidservant's skin was indeed not good originally. It's only after coming to Your Majesty's side, being idle all day and well-fed, that it gradually recovered."

"So you're saying it's my merit?"

"I... suppose so."

"Merit deserves reward, doesn't it?"

With those words finished, Xiao Zheng pulled her into his arms and kissed her deeply.

Actually, in matters of the bedchamber, he didn't particularly care for this because the consorts always had lip tint on their lips, or after washing it off, their lips appeared either too pale or too dark.

All in all, if Xiao Zheng were to rank them, Chun Luo's lips would rank first: tender and pink when calm, crimson when stirred, and when bitten, feeling like a soft, slightly sweet cloud.

This feeling was not bad at all, and Xiao Zheng couldn't help but demand more...

╭(′▽`)╯╰(′▽`)╮

At 3:00 AM, her accursed biological clock woke Chun Luo naturally from her slumber.

She lay on her side in Xiao Zheng's embrace. Last night had been somewhat overindulgent; after emerging from the bathhouse, the two of them had carried on making a fuss in the bedchamber, and in the end, they had fallen asleep from exhaustion without even putting on sleeping robes.

Waking up now, her back pressed against Xiao Zheng's chest, rising and falling with his breathing.

With the weather approaching June, holding each other this closely under a single layer of quilt made Chun Luo feel hot.

Lifting the quilt was out of the question—it might be hot for her, but not necessarily for Xiao Zheng. If she made Xiao Zheng fall ill, her little life probably wouldn't survive.

Chun Luo could only choose to move away from Xiao Zheng. She shifted slightly, wanting to get out of this embrace.

She didn't succeed, however, because Xiao Zheng shifted as well.

Chun Luo couldn't see his face and had no idea whether he was awake or just moving in his sleep, but either way, an arm was wrapped around her waist like an iron hoop.

Next, Chun Luo felt a heat source approach the top of her head.

"Fidgeting about for what? It's not the hour of Mao yet."

His tone was muffled, obviously still mired in sleepiness.

While struggling to turn over, Chun Luo whispered, "Your Majesty, this maidservant is a bit warm. Let's sleep a little further apart."

Xiao Zheng relaxed the pressure of his arm slightly. Chun Luo breathed a sigh of relief and hurriedly moved away—only to feel the hand around her waist suddenly slide upward.

"......Your Majesty?"

Xiao Zheng was already wide awake. He pulled the warm, fragrant creature in his arms over and kneaded her thoroughly, successfully driving the temperature back up.

Chun Luo suppressed a moan, her pants growing increasingly distinct.

Xiao Zheng turned her over so they were face-to-face in an embrace, chuckling softly. "You're acting shy now, but who knows who was crying out so loudly last night!"

Chun Luo thought to herself: *Wasn't that because I was lost in passion? Now that I'm completely sober—and considering that the people carrying washbasins, towels, toothbrushes, and tooth powder are likely already in position—how could I possibly make a sound?*

"Your Majesty... Your Majesty, it'll be time to rise soon, there's not enough time..."

Xiao Zheng's movements paused. He turned his head to glance at the clepsydra and said, "There's about an hour left. I'll be quick."

With the arrow already on the bowstring, Chun Luo could only offer a word of persuasion to express her stance—she certainly wasn't the kind of seductress who hooked the Emperor into exercising first thing in the morning.

During the exercise, Chun Luo couldn't hold back and couldn't keep her voice down, so the people outside naturally heard a bit of it.

Su Youren immediately signaled the others to withdraw and had several buckets of hot water prepared in standby.

Just before the exact hour of Mao, even before Su Youren could go in to call for them to rise, Xiao Zheng called for hot water.

After a thorough washing up, Xiao Zheng strode off full of vigor.

With the remnants of passion still lingering at the corners of her eyes, Chun Luo hastily scurried back to her own room

chapters.title: Follow His Majesty, and only then will there be lychees to eat.
chapters.content:
Chun Luo knew that the Emperor was the person with the least privacy in this world; no matter what he did, a whole bunch of people would be staring.

However, previously she only knew these people existed without knowing where they were.

This morning was different; she knew quite well that those people were right at the entrance of the bedchamber.

That made her feel deeply ashamed.

The moment she stepped outside, she would feel as though people were quietly eyeing her from all directions.

Covering her face, Chun Luo told herself over and over in her heart: *This is the norm of this world, at least the norm of the imperial palace. I have to get used to it!*

*Tap, tap, tap—*

The door knocked. Chun Luo gave a full-body shudder, took a deep breath, discarded the jumbled thoughts in her head, and got up to open the door.

Xia Chan was standing at the threshold.

"Aren't you going to let me in?"

"Come in quickly."

Chun Luo stepped aside to make way. Ever since Xia Chan had mentioned her older sister at Shuiyun Taoist Temple, Chun Luo had felt rather awkward; apart from official matters, she hadn't exchanged words with Xia Chan these past few days.

"Sit down quickly, drink some tea. The tea I have here is just brewed casually."

Chun Luo casually poured a cup of tea for Xia Chan. The tea leaves were good ones, but they were brewed directly with hot water, lacking the multiple steps Xia Chan used.

Xia Chan picked up the teacup, took a sip, frowned slightly, and set it down.

"When you have free time in the future, you can come find me to learn how to brew tea."

Chun Luo: ......

"I came to find you today because I want to tell you something."

Xia Chan hesitated slightly, paused for a moment, and then continued in a low voice: "Someone wants to reinvestigate the incident where the Eldest Princess and Eldest Prince fell into the water. You were in the Imperial Garden at the time and were also summoned to the Palace of Penalties for questioning; you are very likely to be dragged into it."

Chun Luo was startled. A single thought brought sudden clarity—

Reinvestigate what reinvestigation? It was clearly that someone had learned she had been favored and wanted to use this opportunity to get rid of her!

“Well, now that I’ve said what I needed to say, I’ll be on my way. Take care of yourself.”

Xia Chan got up and left immediately, giving Chun Luo no chance to ask her to stay.

Chun Luo hurriedly got up to see her out, and once the door was closed, she slumped back down with a worried expression.

No matter who found out about her being favored, if they told Noble Consort Xian, and Noble Consort Xian really kicked up a fuss to demand a reinvestigation… as a high-ranking consort who had given birth to the First Prince, wouldn't it be easy for her to dispose of a little maid?

Chun Luo irritably collapsed onto her bed, feeling like her little life was becoming more and more incomprehensible—she had clearly succeeded in climbing into the emperor's bed, yet she was still just a little maid at the mercy of others.

And she hadn’t even looked for trouble; she hadn't even stepped out of the Palace of Earthly Purity, yet trouble kept coming to her doorstep.

What’s more, there was another possibility—Xia Chan might have been lying to her as well. After all, her access to information was cut off, and she tended to take anyone at their word...

[System, do you have any lie-detection props?]

[Yes, but this system must remind you that it is very likely the person telling the lie doesn't even know it's false.]

When Chun Luo thought about it, that made sense, and she felt even more dejected.

After sighing for a good long while, Chun Luo still couldn't come up with any solutions. After all, the environment she grew up in since childhood hadn't required her to be skilled at scheming; she simply didn't have that talent.

Seeing that it was almost the hour of *Si* (precisely nine in the morning), Chun Luo quickly tidied herself up and went to the main entrance to wait for Xiao Zheng after court.

She didn't have to wait long before Xiao Zheng arrived.

Chun Luo curtsied in greeting, but Xiao Zheng stepped forward and pulled her up by the arm, his tone lazy: "I told you not to come. I want to paint again."

"Your Majesty, you can paint in the afternoon."

Xiao Zheng gave a noncommittal hum, went to change into his casual robes first, and then headed to the imperial study.

Chun Luo sat to one side to grind the ink. She had expected to be accompanying him through the reading of memorials again today, but she hadn't expected Su Youren to come and report that the Empress, Noble Consort Xian, and Consort De had arrived together to request an audience.

Chun Luo's heart skipped a beat. Could all three of them be here to deal with her? Surely not!

Xiao Zheng put down his brush: "Welcome them to the side hall. I'll go over right now."

Chun Luo quickly stood up and retreated to the side-rear like a little quail. Logically speaking, as a personal attendant, she was supposed to go along, but how could she possibly dare? She had no choice but to shrink back.

Xiao Zheng walked a few steps toward the exit, then looked back: "What are you hiding for?"

Chun Luo cautiously glanced at him, steeled her heart, took two steps forward, and said in a tiny, delicate voice: "Someone told this maid today that when I was sweeping in the Imperial Garden, I might have been connected to certain matters."

As soon as he heard this, Xiao Zheng understood. He had naturally had Chun Luo's background investigated, but the circumstances back then had been complicated, so they hadn't dug too deep. Now that Chun Luo had proactively brought it up, he could ask her about it.

Xiao Zheng walked a bit closer, reached out to cup Chun Luo's face, and spoke in a calm tone: "Then tell me, what did you see that day? Or what did you hear?"

"Later on, when this maid was taken to the Ministry of Punishments, I was questioned too. But I didn't see anything that day; I only heard the sound of someone falling into the water, and I didn't dare to go look, so I went far away."

Chun Luo lowered her gaze, her eyelashes fluttering like a butterfly’s wings, but her voice was very calm.

Xiao Zheng let go of his hand, his tone lifting slightly: "Since you didn't know anything, what are you afraid of?"

Chun Luo reached out to clasp his hand, her tone pitiable: "This maid is lowly and insignificant, with no knowledge or experience, so naturally I'm afraid."

That phrasing wasn't quite right.

Chun Luo only realized it after she spoke, but unfortunately, the words were already out.

Xiao Zheng chuckled softly: "Lowly and insignificant? Is this blaming me? Then you'd better think carefully—if you were sent to the palaces of the Eastern and Western Six, you'd probably only be a Bao-lin, and I would only ever see you in the Hall of Receiving Dew."

Without a single hesitation, Chun Luo immediately said, "Your Majesty, this maid only wants to stay in the Palace of Earthly Purity. Only by following Your Majesty can I get lychees to eat."

Just kidding—in the past, becoming a Bao-lin wouldn't have been a big deal, but now that she knew it was dangerous, wouldn't it be a breeze for the Big Three of the harem to take down a mere Bao-lin?

And to be completely honest, a Bao-lin who wasn't doing well might not even eat as well as she did.

Take lychees, for example: the Empress had only gotten to eat six of them to this day. And her? She had eaten at least three times that number.

Of course, it wasn't just for the sake of food; it was simply that the timing wasn't right.

Chun Luo was rather afraid that Xiao Zheng would wave his hand and chase her out. Her heart tightened, and she looked up at Xiao Zheng, only to see that he still had no expression, his noble demeanor completely unchanged.

Oh wait, he looked slightly disgusted: "It's just a few lychees. You need to fix that short-sighted habit of yours."

Hearing this, Chun Luo became even bolder. She leaned in closer, wrapped her arms around Xiao Zheng's sleeve, pressed her body against him, and made full use of her physical advantages.

Last night's and this morning's experience told her that no matter what Xiao Zheng said about her face, hands, or skin, what he actually liked most was her curvaceous figure.

"Your Majesty, this maid isn't short-sighted at all. This maid just loves eating lychees."

"Talk if you want to talk, why are you pressing against me?"

Chun Luo blushed fiercely (58.0258). This was her first time doing something like this, too.

Xiao Zheng reached out and pinched the flesh of Chun Luo's cheek, his tone carrying a hint of threat: "You're not shy right now, are you? Let go immediately, or I'll deal with you later."

Blushing, Chun Luo obediently let go and retreated two steps, lowering her gaze and assuming an honest, obedient posture
